description: Source code implementing geometric routines for Qhull, including functions for distance calculations, hyperplane computations, vector normalization, and related geometric operations.

methods.name: qh_distplane
methods.description: Calculates the distance from a point to a facet's hyperplane, with optional random joggles.

methods.name: qh_findbest
methods.description: Finds the facet that is furthest below a given point, used in convex hull algorithms.

methods.name: qh_findbesthorizon
methods.description: Searches horizon facets for the best fit relative to a point, considering coplanar and outside facets.

methods.name: qh_findbestnew
methods.description: Finds the best new or horizon facet for a point, used during incremental hull construction.

methods.name: qh_backnormal
methods.description: Solves a linear system via back substitution to find a hyperplane normal vector.

methods.name: qh_gausselim
methods.description: Performs Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting on a matrix.

methods.name: qh_getangle
methods.description: Returns the dot product of two vectors, with optional random joggles.

methods.name: qh_getcenter
methods.description: Computes the arithmetic center of a set of vertices.

methods.name: qh_getcentrum
methods.description: Calculates the centroid of a facet, projecting it onto the hyperplane.

methods.name: qh_getdistance
methods.description: Returns the minimum and maximum distances from vertices of one facet to another.

methods.name: qh_projectpoint
methods.description: Projects a point onto a hyperplane based on the distance.

methods.name: qh_setfacetplane
methods.description: Computes and sets the hyperplane for a facet, including handling near-degenerate cases.

methods.name: qh_sethyperplane_det
methods.description: Sets a hyperplane from a set of points using determinants for 2D, 3D, or 4D.

methods.name: qh_sethyperplane_gauss
methods.description: Computes a hyperplane from points using Gaussian elimination.

methods.name: qh_normalize2
methods.description: Normalizes a vector with optional minimum norm and sign flip.
